Passively increases non-sprinting Movement Speed and non-ability Jump Height.

Grants 30|50|60 Mobility Stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Mobility as a stat is capped at 130. Warlocks and Titans inherently have 30 mobility, while Hunters have <pve 100 /> <pvp [70] />.

Forward (including left and right diagonally) Walk Speed with 0|1|2|3 Mods equipped by class:
• Warlocks and Titans: 5.6|6.2|6.6|6.8 m/s
• Hunters (PvP): 6.4|7|7.6|7.6 m/s
• Hunters (PvE): 7|7.6|7.6|7.6 m/s

Strafing (side-to-side and backwards movement) decreases these speeds by 15%. Strafe speed is capped at 6 m/s.

ADS decreases these speeds by 25% and cannot exceed 6 m/s. Sidearms uniquely only suffer a 15% penalty.

Crouching decreases these speeds by 45%. Crouch speed is capped at 4 m/s.

Holding a Machine Gun, Rocket Launcher, Guarding with a Sword, and certain Exotic Heavy Weapons have an additional 15% movement speed penalty.

Sprint speed is set to 8 m/s by default and is capped at 9 m/s. This cap applies to regular Forward Walk Speed as well.
